about_the_game:
You are Hjorti, a rogue heart trapped inside a demented virtual simulation, tasked with only one thing: Surviving in space by building a giant space station out of interconnected modules to make other floating stations explode in a shower of blood and guts! It’s a retro roguelike slaughter like never before, served with a helping of dark humor and sarcasm.

Bloody Hell!

  • Roguelite With a Twist: It's not a mindless slaughter out there. Each level is an open-ended challenge for you to solve as you see fit, with violence, agility, or a clever mix you prefer...

  • Modular Combat System: Start with a cube. Add more cubes. Cubes with guns. Shields. Specials. Special puzzle pieces that unlock exciting new mayhem options! Experiment, mix, and conquer on your own terms!

  • Big Bad Bosses: Every boss puts your chosen strategy to the test, requiring a different approach. Unique abilities and distinct behaviors mean you need to think on your toes. 

  • More Modes, More Mayhem: Be Hjorti in the story mode. Be Hjorti in endless wave survival mode. Be Hjorti in minigames! Each mode unlocks upgrade points and increases the options for bloody mayhem!

  • Sharp as a Razor Blade: The wit, that is. Journey through the madness, accompanied by Hjorti's foul mouth, cynical jokes, and language that would get you banned from polite society, all with a laid-back attitude as enemies explode like a blood sausage!

content_descriptors.notes:
The game includes jokes in dialogues, which may be of a sexual nature and are not related to real events or people. It also makes jokes about the player, for example, implying that they are performing poorly or doing something wrong, while still supporting social norms in the game. 

Dialogues may reference violent actions against enemies, which are caricatured and have no visual connection to reality. The game also contains visual depictions of blood. Additionally, some dialogues mention real drug names and show caricatured depictions of their use and effects on-screen during gameplay.

  • Processor: Dual Core, 1.6 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 3000 / AMD Radeon HD 6450 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c

  • Processor: Dual/Quad Core, 2.0 GHz

short_description: You are Hjorti, a living heart trapped in an absurd simulation. What does a heart do? Why, use space station modules to build a living weapon, destroy endless enemies, overcome complex bosses, all with a trademark dark sense of humor! Strategize, combine, and survive the madness!
